8.1.1.e: In the contexts that will henceforth be told till the sutra <<पदस्य>> [[8.1.16]], the participating words will get duplicated.

8.1.2.e: When a word gets replicated in the 'सर्वस्य द्वे' अधिकार, the second occurrence is known as आम्रेडित.

8.1.3.e: That which is called अम्रेडित (repeated) is gravely accented.

8.1.4.e: The whole word is अम्रेडित (repeated) when the sense is of 'always' and 'each'.

8.1.5.e: The word परि is repeated when used in the sense of 'with the exception or exclusion of''.

8.1.6.e: 1. प्र 2. सम् 3. उ and 4. उत् are repeated when by so doubling, the foot of a verse is completed.

8.1.7.e: 1. उपरि 2. अधि and 3. अधस् are repeated when it expresses uninterrupted nearness.

8.1.8.e: A Vocative, at the beginning of a sentence, is repeated, when envy, praise, anger, blame, or threat is meant by the speaker.

8.1.9.e: When एक is repeated, it is treated like a member of a बहुव्रीहि समास ।

8.1.10.e: A word is repeated and is treated like a member of a बहुव्रीहि समास when a mental distress over something is expressed.

8.1.11.e: In the following rules, the double-word is treated like a कर्मधारय समास ।

8.1.12.e: An adjective is repeated, when it is meant to express that the said attribute belongs to a thing only to a limited degree and the double word is treated like a कर्मधारय समास ।

8.1.13.e: The words प्रिय and सुख are repeated optionally when they mean 'easily, without any difficulty'.

8.1.14.e: The word यथायथम् is irregularly formed in the sense of 'respectively, fitly, properly'.

8.1.15.e: The word द्वन्द्वम् is irregularly formed in the sense of 'secret' and when it expresses a 'limit', 'a separation', 'employing in a sacrificial vessel' and 'manifestation'.

8.1.16.e: Up to इडाया वा [[8.3.54]], inclusive, should be always supplied in every subsequent sūtra the phrase 'of a word' or 'to the whole of a word'.

8.1.17.e: Up to सगतिरपि तिङ् [[8.1.68]], inclusive, should always be supplied the phrase 'after a पद'.

8.1.18.e: Up to (सामान्यवचनं) विभाषितं विशेषवचने (बहुवचनम्) [[8.1.74]], inclusive, should always be supplied the phrase 'the whole is unaccented, if it does not stand at the beginning of the foot of a verse'.

8.1.19.e: All the syllables of the Vocative Case are unaccented when a word precedes them and they do not stand at the beginning of a hemistich.

8.1.20.e: dual of युष्मद् and अस्मद् are substituted वाम and नौ respectively ।

8.1.21.e: For (the Genitive 6th-Case, Dative -4th Case and Accusative -2nd case) plural of युष्मद् and अस्मद् are substituted वस् and नस् respectively (when a word precedes and these substitutes are अनुदात्त).

8.1.22.e: For the Genitive 6th-Case and Dative -4th Case singular (of युष्मद् and अस्मद् are substituted) ते and मे respectively (when a word precedes and these substitutes are अनुदात्त).

8.1.23.e: For the Accusative -2nd case singular of युष्मद् and अस्मद् are substituted त्वा and मा respectively (when a word precedes and these substitutes are अनुदात्त).

8.1.24.e: when there is in connection with the सर्वनाम any of these - 1. च 'and' 2. वा 'or' 3. ह 'Oh!' 4. अह 'wonderful' or 5. एव 'only'.

8.1.25.e: The above substitutions do not take place also in connection with verbs having the sense of 'seeing' when physical seeing is not denoted.

8.1.26.e: When the सर्वनाम follows a Nominative 1st-Case, which itself is preceded by another word, then the above substitutions may take place optionally.

8.1.27.e: The words गोत्र etc. become unaccented after a finite verb when a contempt or a repetition in intended.

8.1.28.e: A finite verb is unaccented when a word precedes it which is not a finite verb.

8.1.29.e: By the लुट् (Periphrastic Future) is not unaccented when it is preceded by a word which is not a finite verb.

8.1.30.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with the particles 1. यत् 'that', 'because' 2. यदि 'if' 3. हन्त 'also', 'O!' 4. कुवित् 'well' 5. नेत् 'not' 6. चेत् 'if' 7. च 'if' 8. कच्चित् (interrogative particle implying 'I hope' or 'I hope not') and 9. यत्र 'where'.

8.1.31.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with नह when used in the sense of forbidding.

8.1.32.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with सत्य when used in asking a question.

8.1.33.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with अङ्ग when used in a friendly assertion.

8.1.34.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with हि when used in a friendly assertion.

8.1.35.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), the finite verb retains its accent (but not always) in connection with हि when it stands in correlation to another verb, even more than one.

8.1.36.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with यावत् and यथा।

8.1.37.e: But not so when these particles यावत् and यथा immediately precede the verb an denote 'praise'.

8.1.38.e: A finite verb loses its accent when it denotes 'praise' and is joined immediately with यावत् and यथा through the intervention of an उपसर्ग (verbal Preposition).

8.1.39.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with 1. तु 2. पश्य 3. पश्यत and 4. अह when meaning 'praise'.

8.1.40.e: The finite verb retains its accent in connection with अहो when meaning 'praise'.

8.1.41.e: The finite verb optionally retains its accent in connection with अहो in the remaining cases (i.e. where it does not mean 'praise').

8.1.42.e: The finite verb optionally retains its accent in connection with पुरा when it means 'haste' (i.e. when पुरा means 'before').

8.1.43.e: The finite verb optionally retains its accent in connection with ननु when with this particle, permission is asked.

8.1.44.e: The finite verb optionally retains its accent in connection with किम् when with this is asked a question relating to an action and when the verb is not preceded by a preposition or a negation.

8.1.45.e: When however किम् is not added in asking such a question, the finite verb may optionally retain its accent.

8.1.46.e: In connection with एहिमन्ये used diversely in the लृट् (I Future) that follows it, retains its accent.

8.1.47.e: The finite verb optionally retains its accent after जातु when this जातु is not preceded by another word.

8.1.48.e: Also after a form of किम् when the particle चित् follows it and when no other word precedes such form of किम् the finite verb retains its accent.

8.1.49.e: Also after an immediately preceding आहो and उताहो when these follow, no other word, the verb retains its accent.

8.1.50.e: When the above mentioned particles आहो and उताहो do not immediately precede the verb, the verb may optionally retain its accent.

8.1.51.e: The लृट् (I Future) retains its accent in connection with the Imperative of a verb denoting 'motion' ('to go', 'to come', 'to start' etc.) but only in that case, when the subject and object of both the verbs are not wholly different one from another.

8.1.52.e: Also an लोट् (Imperative Mood), following after an Imperative of verbs of 'motion' retains its accent when the subject or object of both the verbs is not wholly different.

8.1.53.e: An Imperative preceded by a preposition and not in the 1st person, following an Imperative of verbs of 'motion', may optionally retain its accent when the कारक is not wholly different.

8.1.54.e: An Imperative with a preposition preceding it, may optionally retain its accent, in connection with हन्त , but not in the 1st person.

8.1.55.e: After आम् , but separated from it by not more than one word, the Vocative retains its accent when the person addressed is not near.

8.1.56.e: A finite verb followed by यत् or हि or तु retains its accent in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

8.1.57.e: A finite verb retains its accent when it is not preceded by a गति Particle -- गतिश्च [[1.4.60]] etc., and when it is followed by 1. चन 2. चिद् 3. इव 4. गोत्र etc., a तद्धित affix, or by its own doubled form.

8.1.58.e: A finite verb, not preceded by a गति , retains its accent before the particles च (1. वा 2. ह 3. अह and 4. एव -- न चवाहाहैवयुक्ते [[8.1.24]]).

8.1.59.e: The first finite verb only retains its accent in connection with च and वा।

8.1.60.e: In connection with ह , the first finite verb retains its accent when an offence against custom is reprimanded.

8.1.61.e: In connection with अह , the first finite verb retains its accent when it refers to various commissions (as well as when a breach of good manners is condemned).

8.1.62.e: When च and अह are elided, the first finite verb still retains its accent when एव with the force of limitation, takes their place.

8.1.63.e: When च (1. वा 2. ह 3. अह and 4. एव -- न चवाहाहैवयुक्ते [[8.1.24]]) are elided the first verb optionally retains its accent.

8.1.64.e: Also in connection with वै and वाव , may optionally, in the छन्दस् (Vedas), the first verb retains its accent.

8.1.65.e: Also in connection with एक and अन्य , optionally in the छन्दस् (Vedas), the first verb retains its accent, when these word have the same meaning ('the one - the other').

8.1.66.e: In connection with यद् in all its forms, the verb retains its accent always.

8.1.67.e: After a word denoting praise belonging to काष्ठादि class the word whose praise is denoted, becomes अनुदात्त ।

8.1.68.e: (After such words denoting praise) the finite verb (which is praised) becomes अनुदात्त even along with the गति , if any, that may precede it.

8.1.69.e: A finite verb along with its preceding गति , if any, become अनुदात्त when a noun denoting the fault of the action follows, with the exception of गोत्र etc.

8.1.70.e: A गति becomes unaccented when followed by another गति .

8.1.71.e: A गति becomes अनुदात्त when followed by an accented finite verb.

8.1.72.e: A preceding Vocative is considered as non-existent (for the purposes of the accent of the following word and the enclitic forms of युष्मद् and अस्मद्).

8.1.73.e: A preceding Vocative, when it conveys a general idea, is not to be considered as if non-existent for the purposes of the subsequent Vocative, which stands in apposition with the former.

8.1.74.e: When the preceding Vocative is in the plural number, it is optionally considered as non-existent, if the subsequent Vocative, in apposition with it, is a specific term.

8.2.1.e: The rules defined in त्रिपादी are non existent with-respect-to the rules of सपादसप्ताध्यायी. Even within त्रिपादी, the later rules are non existent with-respect-to the former rules.

8.2.2.e: The नकारलोप given by 'न लोपः प्रातिपदिकान्तस्य' is असिद्ध only with reference to (1) सुप्-विधि, (2) स्वरविधि, (3) संज्ञाविधि, and (4) तुगागम caused by a कृत्-प्रत्यय.

8.2.3.e: The मु  आदेश is not considered असिद्ध while and after doing the 'ना' आदेश.

8.2.4.e: A स्वरित vowel is the substitute of an अनुदात्त vowel when the latter follows after such a semi-vowel which has replaced an उदात्त (acute accent) or a स्वरित vowel.

8.2.5.e: The single substitute of an unaccented with an उदात्त (acute accent) vowel is उदात्त।

8.2.6.e: The single substitute of an unaccented vowel standing at the beginning of a word, with an उदात्त (acute accent) vowel may optionally be a स्वरित or उदात्त (acute accent).

8.2.7.e: The terminal न् letter of a प्रातिपदिक is omitted if the प्रातिपदिक also gets the पदसंंज्ञा.

8.2.8.a: प्रातिपदिकस्य पदस्य अन्त्यस्य नः लोपः ङि-सम्बुद्ध्यौः न
8.2.8.e:
For a प्रातिपदिक that also gets the पदसंंज्ञा, the terminal न् letter is not omitted in presence of the      
ङि or सम्बुद्धि प्रत्यय.

8.2.9.e: For the म् of the affix मत् is substituted व if the अङ्ग (stem) ends in म् or अ ( and आ) or if these are in the penultimate position; but not after यव etc.

8.2.10.e: The व् is substituted for the म् of मत् after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a mute consonant.

8.2.11.e: The व् is substituted for the म् of मत् when the word so formed is a Name.

8.2.12.e: The following names are irregularly formed 1. आसन्दीवत् 2. अष्ठीवत् 3. चक्रीवत् 4. कक्षीवत् 5. रुमण्वत् and 6. चर्मण्वती। (Reference श्लोक - आसन्दीवति धान्यादं रुक्मिणं हरितस्रजम्। अश्वं बबन्ध सारङ्गं देवेभ्यो अनमेजयः।)

8.2.13.e: The word उदन्वान् is irregularly formed in the sense of 'a sea'.

8.2.14.e: Also राजन्वान् when the sense is of a good government.

8.2.15.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) व् is substituted for the म् of मत् after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इ (or ई) or र्।

8.2.16.e: The affix मत् gets the augment नुट् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in अन्।

8.2.17.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) the affixes तर and तम get the augment नुट् after a stem in न्।

8.2.18.e: For the र् of the root कृप् there is substituted ल्।

8.2.19.e: ल् is substituted for the र् of a preposition when अयते follows.

8.2.20.e: ल् is substituted for the र् of गॄ in the intensive.

8.2.21.e: र् is optionally changed to ल् before an affix beginning with a vowel.

8.2.22.e: The र् of परि is changed to ल् before घ and अङ्क।

8.2.23.e: The last letter of a पद that ends in a संयोग is removed.

8.2.24.e: For a संयोग occurring at end of a पद which contains रेफ as the first letter, the last letter is deleted only if it is a सकार and not otherwise.

8.2.25.e: The स् is elided before an affix beginning with ध।

8.2.26.e: The स् is elided when it is preceded by a झल् consonant (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) and is followed by an affix beginning with a झल् consonant.

8.2.27.e: The स् is elided before an affix beginning with झल् consonant (all consonant except semi-vowels and nasals) when it is preceded by a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a short vowel.

8.2.28.e: The स् is elided after the augment इट् if after this स् the augment ईट् follows.

8.2.29.a: संयोगाद्योः स्कोः पदस्य अन्ते झलि च लोपः
8.2.29.e: If there is a संयोगः at end of a पद, or if there is a संयोगः which is followed by a झल्-वर्ण,  and if the first letter of that संयोगः is either स् or क् , then this letter is deleted.

8.2.30.e: A चवर्गीय letter which occurs at the end of a पद or before झल् letter is converted to the corresponding कवर्गीय letter.

8.2.31.e: A  हकार is converted to a ढकार at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter.

8.2.32.a: दादेः धातोः हः घः झलि पदस्य अन्ते
8.2.32.e: A हकार occurring at end of a दकारादि-धातु is converted to a घकार at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter.

8.2.33.a: द्रुह-मुह-ष्णुह-ष्णिहाम् धातोः हः पदस्य अन्ते झलि घः वा
8.2.33.e: A हकार occurring at end of verbs द्रुहँ, मुहँ, ष्णुहँ and ष्णिहँ   at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter is converted optionally to a घकार.

8.2.34.a: नहः हः धः झलि पदस्य अन्ते
8.2.34.e: The हकार for the verb नह् is converted to धकार at पदान्त or when followed by a झल् letter.

8.2.35.e: The हकार of 'आह्' is converted to थकार when followed by a झल् letter.

8.2.36.e: The laster letter of the word व्रश्च्, भ्रस्ज्, सृज्, मृज्, यज्, राज्, भ्राज् and  शकारान्त /  च्छकारान्त words gets षकारादेश at पदान्त, or when झल् letter is in front.

8.2.37.a: धातोः एकाचः झषन्तस्य बशः स्ध्वोः पदस्य अन्ते च भष्
8.2.37.e: A बश्-वर्ण of an एकाच् and झषन्त part of a verb is converted to a भष् वर्ण - (1) in presence of a सकार, (2) in presence of a  the word ध्व, or (3) at end of a पद

8.2.38.a: दधः तथोः झषन्तस्य एकाचः बशः भष् स्वोः तथोः च
8.2.38.e: The बश्-letter of the the झषन्त-एकाच्-अवयव present in the 'दध्' form of the verb root 'धा' is converted to a corresponding भष् letter when followed by  तकार, थकार, सकार, or the word ध्व.

8.2.39.e: A झल् letter occurring at end of a पद is converted to the corresponding जश् letter.

8.2.40.e: The तकार and थकार that follows a झष् letter is converted to  धकार. But this conversion does not happen for the verb  root 'धा'.

8.2.41.e: षकार and  ढकार not occurring at end of a पद are converted to  ककार when followed by सकार.

8.2.42.e: After र and द for the त of the Participial suffix त and तवत् there is substituted न and the same substitution takes place also for the preceding द।

8.2.43.e: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after a root ending in आ and commencing with a conjunct consonant, if the latter contains a semi-vowel.

8.2.44.e: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after the roots लू and those that follow it.

8.2.45.e: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after a root which has an indicatory ओ in the धातुपाठ।

8.2.46.e: For the त of the निष्ठा there is substituted न after क्षि when the root-vowel is lengthened.

8.2.47.e: The निष्ठा त is changed to न after श्यै but not when the participle denotes 'cold'.

8.2.48.e: The निष्ठा त is changed to न after अञ्च् but not when it is in connection with an Ablative -5th case.

8.2.49.e: The निष्ठा त is changed to न after दिव् when the sense is not that of 'play'.

8.2.50.e: The word निर्वाण is irregularly formed by changing the निष्ठा त is changed to न when the sense is not that of 'wind'.

8.2.51.e: क is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root शुष्।

8.2.52.e: व is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root पच् 'to cook' ।

8.2.53.e: म is substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root क्षै।

8.2.54.e: म is optionally substituted for the निष्ठा त after the root स्तयै preceded by प्र।

8.2.55.e: The irregular participles 1. फुल्ल 2. क्षीब 3. कृश and 4. उल्लाघ are formed then only, when no preposition precedes them.

8.2.56.e: The निष्ठा त is optionally changed to न after 1. नुद 2. विद 3. उन्द 4. त्रा 5. घ्रा and 6. ह्री।

8.2.57.e: The निष्ठा त is not changed to न after 1. ध्या 2. ख्या 3. पॄ 4. मूर्छि and 5. मद।

8.2.58.e: The irregularly formed participle वित्त denotes 'possessions' and 'renowned'.

8.2.59.e: The word भित्त is irregularly formed in the sense of 'a fragment, a portion'.

8.2.60.e: The word ऋण is irregularly formed in the sense of 'debt.

8.2.61.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas) we have the following irregular participles - 1. नसत्त 2. निषत्त 3. अनुत्त 4. प्रतूर्त 5. सूर्त्त and 6. गूर्त्त।

8.2.62.e: The word ending in a क्विन्-प्रत्यय gets a कवर्गादेश at पदान्त ।

8.2.63.e: The word नश् undergoes an optional कुत्वम् at पदान्त.

8.2.64.e: A मकार occurring at end of a धातु which in turn occurs at end of a पद is converted to नकार.

8.2.65.e: न is substituted for the म of a root before the affixes beginning with म and व।

8.2.66.e: The सकार at end of a पद, and the षकार at end of the सजुष् पद get a रुँ-आदेश ।

8.2.67.e: The words अवयाः, श्वेतवाः, पुरोडाः are considered derived.

8.2.68.e: The word अहन् gets रुँत्व at पदान्त.

8.2.69.e: The word अहन् gets रेफादेश at पदान्त, except when followed by a सुप्-प्रत्यय.

8.2.70.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), both रु and र् are substituted for the final 1. अमनस् 2. ऊधस् and 3. अवस्।

8.2.71.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), both रु and र् may replace the final of the word भुवस् when used as a महाव्याहृति।

8.2.72.e: The सकारान्त वसुँ-प्रत्ययान्तशब्द, स्रंसु-शब्द, ध्वंसु-शब्द and अनडुह्-शब्द get a दकारादेशः at पदान्त.

8.2.73.e: द is substituted for the final स् of a root with the exception of अस् 'to be' , before the personal ending ति (त्) when it stands at the end of a word.

8.2.74.e: द् or रु may optionally be substituted for the स् of a root, , before the personal ending सि (स्) when such स् stands at the end of a word.

8.2.75.e: द् or रु may optionally be substituted for the द् of a root, , before the personal ending सि (स्) when such द् stands at the end of a word.

8.2.76.a: पदस्य र्वोः धातोः उपधायाः इकः दीर्घः
8.2.76.e: The उपधा letter of a रेफान्त or a वकारान्त पद which also has a धातुसंज्ञा becomes दीर्घ if that letter belongs to the इक् प्रत्याहार.

8.2.77.a: र्वोः  धातोः उपधायाः इकः हलि दीर्घः
8.2.77.e: The उपधा letter of a रेफान्त or a वकारान्त धातु becomes दीर्घ if that letter belongs to the इक् प्रत्याहार and if the धातु is followed by a हल् letter.

8.2.78.a: धातोः उपधयोः हल्परयोः र्वोः उपधायाः इकः दीर्घः
8.2.78.e: When a धातु has (1)  a हल्-letter at the end (2) a रेफ / वकार in the second-last position, and (3) an इक् letter in the third-last position, then the इक् letter undergoes a दीर्घादेश.

8.2.79.e: The lengthening of a vowel does not take place under हलि च [[8.2.77]] when the nominal अङ्ग (stem) ending in र् or व् is called भ (i.e. when a य् follows) and also not in कुर् and छुर्।

8.2.80.e: When the सर्वनाम अदस् does not end in स् then there is substituted उ or ऊ for the vowel after द् , and म् for द्।

8.2.81.e: For the ए coming after the द् of अदस् , there is substituted ई , and द् is changed to म् when plurality is to be expressed.

8.2.82.e: In the context of all the सूत्राणि till the end of this पाद, the टि-संज्ञक स्वर of the sentence would be considered प्लुत and उदात्त.
8.2.82.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.83.a: अशूद्रविषये प्रत्यभिवादे वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः ।
8.2.83.e: The टिसंज्ञक of the sentence which is used to answer a greeting, becomes प्लुत  and उदात्त, provided that the sentence is not addressed to a शूद्र.
8.2.83.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.84.a: दूरात् हूते वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः
8.2.84.e: The टिसंज्ञक स्वर of the sentence used for calling someone from a distance becomes प्लुत and उदात्त.
8.2.84.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.85.a: है-हे-प्रयोगे दूरात् हुते वाक्यस्य है-हे प्लुतः उदात्तः
8.2.85.e: If the words हे / है are used in a sentence that is used for calling someone from a distance, then the स्वर of the only हे / है becomes प्लुत and उदात्त.
8.2.85.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.86.a: दूरात् हुते वाक्यस्य अनृतः अनन्त्यस्य अपि एकैकस्य गुरोः प्राचाम् प्लुतः उदात्तः
8.2.86.e: For the words whose टि has been mandated to be प्लुत and उदात्त by the earlier sutras, all the other ऋकारभिन्न गुरु letters of that word can also take turns one by one to become प्लुत and उदात्त, according to the experts of the east.
8.2.86.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.87.e: The vowel in ओम् is प्लुत in the beginning of a sacred text.
8.2.87.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.88.e: The vowel of ये becomes प्लुत in a sacred text when it is used in a sacrificial work.
8.2.88.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.89.e: In a sacrificial work ओ3म् is substituted for the final vowel with the consonant, if any, that may follow it, in a sentence.
8.2.89.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.90.e: The last vowel at the end of मन्त्र-s called याज्य , when used in sacrificial works is प्लुत and has the acute accent (उदात्त).
8.2.90.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.91.e: In a sacrificial work, the first syllable of 1. ब्रूहि 2. प्रेष्य 3. श्रौषट् and 4.आवह is प्लुत।
8.2.91.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.92.e: In an order given to अग्नीध्र priest, the first syllable as well as the succeeding syllable is प्लुत.
8.2.92.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.93.e: हि at the end of an answer to a question may optionally be प्लुत।
8.2.93.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.94.e: The end syllable of that sentence is optionally प्लुत when it asserts something which has been refuted and is used by the victor by way of censure.
8.2.94.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.95.e: The end syllable of an आम्रेडित Vocative Case is प्लुत when threat is expressed.
8.2.95.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.96.e: The final syllable of a finite verb used as a threat becomes प्लुत when the word अङ्ग is joined with it and it demands another sentence to complete the conclusion.
8.2.96.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.97.e: The end syllable of those sentences is प्लुत which denote acts of reflection (or balancing between two alternatives).
8.2.97.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.98.e: In the common speech, the end vowel of the first alternative is only प्लुत।
8.2.98.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.99.e: The end syllable of the sentence which expresses assent or promise or listening to, is प्लुत।
8.2.99.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.100.e: The end vowel at the end of a question or of a praise is प्लुत, but unaccented.
8.2.100.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.101.e: The end vowel at the end of a sentence becomes अनुदात्त and प्लुत when the particle चित् is used, denoting comparison.
8.2.101.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.102.e: In 1. उपरि 2. स्विद् and 3. आसीद् the end vowel is अनुदात्त and प्लुत।
8.2.102.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.103.e: Of the two Vocatives of the same form standing at the beginning of a sentence, the end vowel of the first becomes प्लुत and स्वरित when envy, praise, anger or blame is expressed.
8.2.103.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.104.e: When an error against polite usage is censured or when a benediction or a bidding is intended, the end syllable of a finite verb becomes प्लुत and स्वरित , if this requires another sentence to complete the sense.
8.2.104.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.105.e: In a question or narration, the end vowel of a word, though not final in a sentence, becomes प्लुत and स्वरित , as well as the word which is final in a sentence.
8.2.105.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.106.e: In forming the प्लुत of the diphthongs s ए and ओ , their last element इ and उ get the प्लुत।
8.2.106.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.107.e: In the diphthongs which are not प्रगृह्य -- ईदूदेद्द्विवचनं प्रगृह्यम् [[1.1.11]] etc. and which become प्लुत under the circumstances mentioned in प्रत्यभिवादेशूद्रे [[8.2.83]] etc., but not when that circumstance is a call from a distance -- दूराद्धूते च [[8.2.84]]; for the first half, there is substituted the prolated आ and for the second portion इ or उ।
8.2.107.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · वाक्यस्य टेः प्लुतः उदात्तः

8.2.108.e: For these vowels इ or उ are substituted य् and व् when a vowel follows them in a संहिता (in an unbroken flow of speech).

8.3.1.a: मतुवसौ पदस्य संहितायाम् सम्बुद्धौ छन्दसि  रुँ
8.3.1.e: In the Vedic usages, the पद ending in मतुँप् or क्वसुँ प्रत्यय undergo रुँत्वम् in the formation of सम्बोधन-एकवचन form.

8.3.2.a: अत्र पदस्य रोः पूर्वस्य वा अनुनासिकः
8.3.2.e: For the रुँ generated using the rules from this रूत्वप्रकरण, the letter before  this रुँ is optionally converted to an अनुनासिक.
8.3.2.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.3.a: अत्र पदस्य रोः पूर्वस्य आतः अटि नित्यमनुनासिकः
8.3.3.e: In this रूत्वप्रकरण, The रुँ that gets constructed at end of a पद causes an अनुनासिक of the आकार just preceding it.
8.3.3.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.4.e: If the रुँ letter generated in this रूत्वप्रकरण does not cause the previous letter to get an अनुनासिक, then it will generate an अनुस्वार आगम just after that previous letter.
8.3.4.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.5.e: When followed by  सुट् आगम, the मकार of सम् is converted to रुँ.
8.3.5.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.6.e: In the context of संहिता, when the word पुम् is followed by a letter from खय्  प्रत्याहार which in turn is followed by a letter form अम् प्रत्याहार, the मकार of पुम् is converted to रुँ.
8.3.6.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.7.a: अम्परे छवि पदस्य नः रुँ, अप्रशान्
8.3.7.e: In the context of संहिता, when a पदान्त नकार is followed by a letter from छव् प्रत्याहार, which in turn is followed by a letter from अम् प्रत्याहार, then the नकार is converted to रुँ. But this conversion does not happen for the word 'प्रशान्'.
8.3.7.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.8.a: अम्परे छवि नः रुँ उभयथा ऋक्षु
8.3.8.e: In the context of संहिता and in the vedas, when a पदान्त नकार is followed by a letter from छव् प्रत्याहार, which in turn is followed by a letter from अम् प्रत्याहार, then the नकार is optionally converted to रुँ.
8.3.8.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.9.a: दीर्घात् समानपादे पदस्य नः रुँ ऋक्षु अटि उभयथा
8.3.9.e: In the context of वेदाः - If a पदान्त-नकार present after a दीर्घ स्वर is followed by a letter from the अट् प्रत्याहार in the same पाद, then the नकार is optionally converted to रुँ.
8.3.9.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.10.e: In the context of संहिता, the ending नकार of the word नॄन् , when followed by पकार is optionally converted to रुँ.
8.3.10.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.11.e: In the context of संहिता, when the word स्वतवान् is followed by the word पायु, the नकार of स्वतवान् is optionally converted to  रुँ.
8.3.11.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.12.e: The नकार of  'कान्' is converted to रुँ when followed by an आम्रेडित.
8.3.12.k: पदस्य · पूर्वत्रासिद्धम् · संहितायाम् · अत्रानुनासिकः पूर्वस्य तु वा

8.3.13.e: A ढकार is removed when it is followed by another  ढकार in the context of संहिता.

8.3.14.e: A रेफ is removed when it is followed by another  रेफ in the context of संहिता.

8.3.15.e: A र् present at end of a  पद is converted to a विसर्ग when it is either followed by nothing, or when it is followed by a खर् letter in the context of संहिता.

8.3.16.e: In presence of the सुप् प्रत्यय of सप्तमी-बहुवचन, a पदान्त र्-वर्ण is converted to a विसर्ग only if that र् is generated from रुँ, and not otherwise.

8.3.17.e: In the context of संहिता, A पदान्त रुँ that is present either at the end of भोस्/भगोस्/अघोस्, or after the letter अ/आ is converted to यकार when followed by a letter from the अश् प्रत्याहार.

8.3.18.e: In the context of संहिता, according to शाकटायन, the पदान्त-वकार and  पदान्त-यकार, when followed by a letter from अश्-प्रत्याहार are converted respectively to  लघु-उच्चारण-वकार and लघु-उच्चारण-यकार.

8.3.19.a: पदस्य अपूर्वयोः व्योः अशि शाकल्यस्य लोपः
8.3.19.e: According to Shakalya, a वकार/यकार present at end of a  पद and situated after अ/आ gets removed when it is followed by a letter from अश् प्रत्याहार in the context of संहिता.

8.3.20.a: ओतः पदस्य यः अशि लोपः गार्ग्यस्य
8.3.20.e: Non-लघूच्चारण-यकार present at end of a  पद and situated after the letter ओ gets removed when it is followed by a letter from अश् प्रत्याहार in the context of संहिता.

8.3.21.e: A पदान्तयकार and a पदान्तवकार coming after an अकार is removed when followed by the पद उञ् in the context of संहिता.

8.3.22.a: भो-भगो-अघो-अपूर्वस्य पदस्य यः हलि लोपः सर्वेषाम्
8.3.22.e: In the context of संहिता, all the grammarians say that the normal यकार as well as the लघु-उच्चारण-यकार is removed when it is followed by a हल्-letter, provided that such a यकार occurs at end of a पद and comes after the letter अ , or if such a यकार occurs at the end of the words भोस्, भगोस्, or अघोस्.

8.3.23.e: In the context of संहिता, the मकार at the end of a पद is converted to अनुस्वार when it is followed by a हल् वर्ण.

8.3.24.e: In the context of संहिता, a मकार and a नकार which do not occur at the end of a पद are converted to अनुस्वार when followed by a झल् letter.

8.3.25.e: When the verb सम् + राज् gets the क्विप् pratyay, the म् of सम् is converted to म् itself.

8.3.26.a: पदस्य मः मपरे हे मः वा
8.3.26.e: In the context of संहिता, if a पदान्तमकार is followed by 'ह् + म्' then that पदान्तमकार is optionally converted to मकार.

8.3.27.e: In the context of संहिता, if a पदान्तमकार is followed by 'ह् + न्' then that पदान्तमकार is optionally converted to नकार.

8.3.28.a: पदस्य ङ्णोः शरि कुक् टुक् वा
8.3.28.e: In the context of संहिता, a ङकार and a णकार at end of a पद optionally get कुक् and  टुक् आगम respectively.

8.3.29.e: In the context of संहिता,  a सकार present after a पदान्त डकार optionally gets a धुट् आगम.

8.3.30.e: In the context of संहिता,  a सकार present after a पदान्त नकार optionally gets a धुट् आगम.

8.3.31.e: In the context of संहिता, a नकार occurring at end of a पद optionally gets a तुगागम when followed by a शकार.

8.3.32.a: ह्रस्वात् ङमः पदात् अचि नित्यम् ङमुट् ।
8.3.32.e: In the context of संहिता, अ ङ्/ण्/न् letter occurring after a ह्रस्व स्वर causes a corresponding ङुट् / णुट्  / नुट्  आगम to an अच् letter following it.

8.3.33.a: पदस्य मयः उञः वः वा अचि
8.3.33.e: In the context of संहिता, when a letter of the मय् प्रत्याहार occurring at end of a पद is followed by word उञ् which in turn is followed by a स्वर, then the word उञ् is optionally converted to a वकार.

8.3.34.e: A विसर्ग occurring at end of a पद is converted to a सकार when followed by a letter from the खर् प्रत्याहार.

8.3.35.e: A विसर्ग is converted to विसर्ग if it is followed by a  खर् letter after which a  शर् letter is present.

8.3.36.e: When a विसर्ग is followed by a letter from the शर्प्रत्याहार, the विसर्ग optionally remains as विसर्ग.

8.3.37.e:
When a विसर्ग is followed by a ककार or a खकार, it is converted either to a जिह्वामूलीय or to a विसर्ग. 
When a विसर्ग is followed by a पकार or a फकार, it is converted either to a उपध्मानीय or to a विसर्ग.

8.3.38.e: A पदान्त विसर्ग is converted to a सकार when it is followed by the प्रत्ययाः पाश्य, कल्प, क, काम्य.

8.3.39.e: A पदान्त विसर्ग which comes after a letter from the इण् प्रत्याहार, and which is followed by प्रत्ययाः - पाश्य, कल्प, क, काम्य - is converted to a षकार.

8.3.40.e: The विसर्ग  of गतिसंज्ञक नमस्  and पुरस् words is converted to सकार when followed by कवर्ग letter or a  पवर्ग letter.

8.3.41.e: A विसर्ग present after an इकार or an उकार which is not made from a प्रत्यय is converted to ष in presence of a कवर्ग or a पवर्ग.

8.3.42.e: The विसर्ग of the word तिरस् is optionally converted to सकार in presence of कवर्ग / पवर्ग letter.

8.3.43.a: कृत्वः-अर्थे द्विस्-त्रिस्-चतुः इणः विसर्जनीयस्य कुप्वोः अन्यतरस्याम् सः
8.3.43.e: For the words द्विस् (= twice), त्रिस्  (= thrice), and चतुर् = (four times) which are used to indicate frequency, their विसर्ग when followed by a letter from कवर्ग or पवर्ग is optionally converted to ष्.

8.3.44.a: इसुसोः विसर्जनीयस्य कुप्वोः अन्यतरस्याम् षः सामर्थ्ये
8.3.44.e: The विसर्ग of the इस्/उस्-प्रत्यय when followed by a letter from कवर्ग or पवर्ग is optionally converted to a षकार whenever the words involved in the सन्धि are associated with each other.

8.3.45.a: समासे इसुसोः विसर्जनीयस्य कुप्वोः नित्यम् षः सामर्थ्ये, अनुत्तरपदस्थस्य ।
8.3.45.e: While doing a समास, the विसर्ग of the इस्/उस्-प्रत्यय when followed by a letter from कवर्ग or पवर्ग is always converted to a षकार whenever the words involved in the समास are associated with each other. However, if the पूर्वपद of this समास is a समास on its own, then the षत्व is completely prohibited.

8.3.46.a: अतः अनव्ययस्य विसर्जनीयस्य समासे कृ-कमि-कंस-कुम्भ-पात्र-कुशा-कर्णीषु सः, अनुत्तरपदस्थस्य
8.3.46.e:
While doing a समास, if all the following conditions are met - 
1. the पूर्वपद ends in a विसर्ग that follows an अकार, 
2. the उत्तरपद is either a form of the verb 'कृ', or a form of the verb 'कमि' or is one of these words - कंस/कुम्भ/पात्र/कुशा/कर्णी
3. पू्र्वपद is not an अव्यय
4.  पू्र्वपद is not a समास
- then the विसर्ग of the पूर्वपद is converted to सकार.

8.3.47.a: अधः-शिरसोः समासे विसर्जनीयस्य नित्यम् सः पदे, अनुत्तरपदस्थस्य
8.3.47.e: While doing a समास, if the पूर्वपद is either the word अधः or the word शिरः and if the the उत्तरपद the word पद, then then the विसर्ग of the पूर्वपद is converted to सकार. However, if the पूर्वपद is itself a समास, then this सकारादेश does not happen.

8.3.48.e: For the words in the कस्कादिगण, the विसर्ग is to be converted to षकार / सकार as shown for each word.

8.3.49.e: स् may optionally be substituted for the विसर्ग before a hard guttural or a labial in the छन्दस् (Vedas); but neither before प्र , nor before a doubled word.

8.3.50.e: The विसर्ग is changed to स् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before 1. कः 2. करत् 3. करति 4. कृधि and 5. कृतः but not so in the विसर्ग of अदितिः।

8.3.51.e: The विसर्ग of the Ablative -5th case is changed to स् before परि meaning 'over'.

8.3.52.e: स् may diversely be substituted for the विसर्ग of the Ablative -5th case before the verb पातु in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

8.3.53.e: For the विसर्ग  of the Genitive 6th-Case there is substituted स् in the छन्दस् (Vedas) before 1. पति 2. पुत्र 3. पृष्ठ 4. पार 5. पद 6. पयस्  and 7. पोष।

8.3.54.e: स् is optionally substituted for the विसर्ग of इडाया before पति etc. -- षष्ठ्याः पतिपुत्रपृष्ठपारपदपयस्पोषेषु [[8.3.53]], in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

8.3.55.e: This is an अधिकार, which goes till the end of the पाद. For the स्थानी that does not occur at end of a पद, the closest 'मूर्धन्य' letter comes as the आदेश.

8.3.56.e: The अपदान्त-सकार present in the 'साड्' form of the verb सह् is converted to षकार.

8.3.57.e: This is an अधिकार, which goes till the end of the पाद. The कार्य designated in this अधिकार happens for a स्थानी that follows an इण् letter or a letter from कवर्ग.

8.3.58.a: नुम्-विसर्जनीय-शर्-व्यवाये अपि अपदान्तस्य इण्कोः सः मूर्धन्यः
8.3.58.e: The षकारादेश mandated in the इण्कोः अधिकार happens even when at most one of अनुस्वार/विसर्ग/शकार/षकार/सकार appears between the इण्/कुवर्ग वर्ण and the सकार.

8.3.59.e: An अपदान्त सकार that was obtained either as an आदेश or through a प्रत्यय  is converted to षकार when it follows a letter from इण्-प्रत्याहार or a कवर्ग.

8.3.60.e: The सकार of the verb roots शास्/वस्/घस् is converted to षकार when it follows a letter from the इण्-प्रत्याहार or the कवर्ग.

8.3.61.e: ष् is substituted for the स् after इ or उ in the reduplication of a Desiderative, if the स् of सन् is changed to ष् but only in स्तु and in Causative of roots which in the धातुपाठ begin with ष्।

8.3.62.e: स is substituted for the स् after the reduplicate of षण् Desiderative of the Causatives of 1. स्विद् 2. स्वद्  and 3. सह्।

8.3.63.e: (The substitution of ष् for स् to be taught hereafter, will take place) for all roots up to सित्  exclusive in परिनिविभ्यः सेवसितसयसिवुसहसुट्स्तुस्वञ्जाम् [[8.3.70]], even when the augment अट् intervenes (between the स and the efficient letter).

8.3.64.e: In स्था etc. up to सित् exclusive -- उपसर्गात् सुनोतिसुवतिस्यतिस्तौतिस्तोभतिस्थासेनय सेधसिचसञ्जस्वञ्जाम् [[8.3.65]] to परिनिविभ्यः सेवसितसयसिवुसहसुट्स्तुस्वञ्जाम् [[8.3.70]], this substitution of ष् takes place then also, when the reduplicate intervenes and the स of the reduplicate is also changed to ष।

8.3.65.e: ष् is substituted for स् after an इ and उ of an उपसर्ग (Preposition) in the following verbs - 1. सू (सुनोति) 2. सू (सवति) 3. सो (स्यति -- ओतः श्यनि [[7.3.71]]) 5. स्तु (स्तौति - उतो वृद्धिर्लुकि हलि [[7.3.89]]) 6. स्तुभ (स्तोभते) 7. स्था 8. सेनय (Denominative) 9. सिध् (सेधति) 10.  सिच् 11. सञ्ज्  and 12. स्वञ्ज्।

8.3.66.e: The  स् of सद् is changed to ष after an उपसर्ग (Preposition) having an इ or उ , but not after प्रति।

8.3.68.e: The  स् of स्तम्भ् is changed into to ष after the उपसर्ग (Preposition) अव in the sense of 'support' and 'contiguity'.

8.3.69.e: The ष् is substituted for the स् of स्वन् after वि  and अव when the sense is 'to smack while eating'.

8.3.70.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of 1. सेव् 2. सित 3. सय 4. सिव् 5. सह 6. the augment सुट् 7.  स्तु  and 8. स्वज् after the उपसर्ग (Prepositions)  परि , नि  and वि।

8.3.71.e: The ष् change may take place optionally in the सिव् and the rest (of the last sūtra) even when the augment अ intervenes between the उपसर्ग (Prepositions)  परि , नि  and वि and the verb.

8.3.72.e: ष् is optionally the substitute of the स् of स्यन्द् after the उपसर्ग (Prepositions) अनु , वि , परि , अभि  and वि when the subject is not a living being.

8.3.73.e: ष् is optionally the substitute of the स् of स्कन्द् after the उपसर्ग (Preposition) वि but not in the participles in त and तवत।

8.3.74.e: ष् is optionally the substitute of the स् of स्कन्द् after the उपसर्ग (Preposition) परि everywhere.

8.3.75.e: The word परिस्कन्द is used without the cerebral change in the country of Eastern Bharata.

8.3.76.e: ष् is optionally the substitute of the स् of स्फुर् and स्फुल् after the उपसर्ग (Prepositions) निस् , नि  and वि।

8.3.77.e: ष् is always the substitute of the स् of स्कम्भ after the उपसर्ग (Preposition) वि।

8.3.78.e: The cerebral sound is substituted in the room of ध् of षीध्वम्  and of the personal-endings of the Aorist and the लिट् (Perfect Tense), after a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इण् (a vowel other than अ).

8.3.79.e: The cerebral sound is optionally substituted for the ध् of षीध्वम्  and of the Aorist and the लिट् (Perfect Tense) after the augment इट् when the stem ends in inn

8.3.80.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of सङ्ग after the word अङ्गुलि in a compound.

8.3.81.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्थानम् when preceded by भीरु in a compound.

8.3.82.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of 1. स्तुत 2. स्तोम  and 3. सोम when preceded by अग्नि in a compound.

8.3.83.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्तोम after ज्योतिस्  and  आयुस् in a compound.

8.3.84.e: ष् is optionally substituted for the स् of स्वसृ after मातृ  and पितृ in a compound.

8.3.85.e: ष् is optionally substituted for the स् of स्वसृ after मातुर्  and पितुर् in a compound.

8.3.86.e: ष् is optionally substituted for the स् of स्तन् after the double उपसर्ग (Preposition) अभि निस् when the word so formed is the name of a particular letter (विसर्ग).

8.3.87.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of the verb अस् 'to be' when it is followed by a vowel or य् and is preceded by प्रादुः or an उपसर्ग (Preposition) इ or उ having in it.

8.3.88.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्वप् , सूति  and सम after सु , वि , निर्  and दुर्।

8.3.89.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्ना after नि and नदी when the word so formed denotes 'dexterous'.

8.3.90.e: The word प्रतिष्णात is irregularly formed when meaning 'sūtra'.

8.3.91.e: The word कपिष्ठल is irregularly formed denoting the founder of a गोत्र (Patronymic) of that name.

8.3.92.e: The word प्रष्ठ is irregularly formed when denoting 'a chief' or 'one who goes in front'.

8.3.93.e: The word विष्टर is irregularly formed in the sense of 'tree' and 'seat'.

8.3.94.e: Also when it is the name of a meter, the irregular form विष्टर is used.

8.3.95.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्थिरः after the words गवि  and  युधि।

8.3.96.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्थल after वि , कु , शमि  and परि।

8.3.97.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्थ after 1. अम्ब 2. आम्ब 3. गो 4. भूमि 5. सव्य 6. अप 7. द्वि 8. त्रि 9. कु 10. शेकु 11. शङ्क्वु 12. अङ्गु 13. मञ्जि 14. पुञ्जि 15. परमे 16. बर्हिस् 17. दिवि  and 18 अग्नि।

8.3.98.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of the words सुषामान् etc.

8.3.99.e: ष् is substituted for the स् when followed by ए and preceded by इण् or कु , when the word is a name and when the स् is not preceded by ग्।

8.3.100.e: ष् is optionally substituted for the स् when the preceding word is the name of a Lunar mansion.

8.3.101.e: ष् is substituted for the final स् preceded by a उ before a तद्धित affix beginning with त।

8.3.102.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of निस् before the verb तप् when meaning is not that of 'repeatedly making red hot'.

8.3.103.e: The स् standing in the inner half of a stanza is changed to ष्  before the त of त्वम् etc. and युष्मद्।

8.3.104.e: In the opinion of some, the above change takes place in the यजुर्वेद also.

8.3.105.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of स्तुत in the छन्दस् (Vedas), in the opinion of some.

8.3.106.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas), ष् is substituted for the स् when it stands in the beginning of a second word, preceded by a word ending in इ etc.

8.3.107.e: In the छन्दस् (Vedas),  ष् is substituted for the स् of the particle सु when preceded by a word having in it the change-effecting letter इ etc.

8.3.108.e: The स of the verb सन् , when it loses its न् is changed to ष , under the same circumstances.

8.3.109.e: ष् is substituted for the स् of सह after पृतना  and ऋत।

8.3.110.e: The ष् substitution does not take place if र् follows the स् as well as in 1. सृप 2. सृज 3. स्पृश 4. स्पृह  and 5. सवन etc.

8.3.111.e: The ष् substitution does not take place in the affix सात् and for that स् which stands at the beginning of a word.

8.3.112.e: The ष् substitution does not take place in the स् of सिच् of the Intensive.

8.3.113.e: The ष् substitution does not take place in the स् of the verb सेध when the meaning is that of moving.

8.3.114.e: The words प्रतिस्तब्ध and निस्तब्ध are anomalous.

8.3.115.e: The ष् substitution does not take place in the स् of सोढ form of the root सह।

8.3.116.e: The ष् substitution does not take place in the reduplicated Aorist of the roots 1. स्तम्भ् 2. सिव्  and 3. सह।

8.3.117.e: The ष् substitution does not take place in the स् of सु (सुनोति) in the Future, Conditional and Desiderative.

8.3.118.e: The ष् substitution does not take place in the स् of सद्  and ष्वञ्ज् after the reduplicate in the लिट् (Perfect Tense).

8.3.119.e: The ष् is optionally substituted in the छन्दस् (Vedas) after the उपसर्ग (Prepositions) नि , वि  and अभि when the augment अट् intervenes.

8.4.1.e: a नकार occurring immediately after ष् or र्  in the same पद is converted to a णकार.

8.4.2.a: रषाभ्याम् नः णः समानपदे अट्-कु-पु-आङ्-नुम्-व्यवाये अपि
8.4.2.e: a नकार occurring after ष् or र् in the same पद is converted to a णकार even when it is separated from the ष् or र्  by one or more letters from the अट् प्रत्याहार, कवर्ग, पवर्ग, आङ् , or अनुस्वार.

8.4.3.a: संज्ञायाम् पूर्वपदात् रषाभ्याम् नः णः, अगः ।
8.4.3.e: For a समस्तपद which is defined as a संज्ञा, The र् and ष् present in the  पूर्वपद causes the णत्वम् of नकार from the उत्तरपद, as long as there is no गकार in between.

8.4.4.e: The न of वन , is changed into ण , when preceded by the words पुरगा , मिश्रका , सिध्रका , शारिका , कोटरा and अग्रे , as first members of the compound, and the whole compound is a name.

8.4.5.e: The न of वन , is replaced by ण , even when the compound is not a Name, when it is preceded by the words प्र , निर् , अन्तर , शर , इक्षु , प्लक्ष , आम्र , कार्ष्य , खदिर and पीयूक्षा।

8.4.6.e: The न of वन , is optionally replaced by ण , when the cause of change occurs in the first member of the compound and which denotes a perennial herb or forest tree.

8.4.7.e: The ण is the substitute of न of अहन् , when it is preceded by a word ending in अ , having in it a letter capable of producing a change.

8.4.8.e: The न of वाहन is changed into ण , when the letter producing the change, occurs in the first member of a compound, denoting the thing carried.

8.4.9.e: The न of पान is changed into ण , when occurs as the second member of a compound, the first member of which contains a letter causing change; and the whole compound denotes a country or people.

8.4.10.e: Optionally when the compound denotes a condition or an instrument, the न् of पान is changed to ण , when it is a second member, the cause of change occurring in the first member in a compound.

8.4.11.e: Optionally ण is substituted for न when it stands at the end of a Nominal-stem (प्रातिपदिक) or is the augment नुम् or is न of a case-affix, (when the cause of change occurs in the first member of the compound).

8.4.12.a: पूर्वपदात् रषाभ्यां प्रातिपदिकान्त-नुम्-विभक्तिषु एकाच्-उत्तरपदे नः णः , अट्कुप्वाङ्नुम्व्यवाये अपि
8.4.12.e: For a समस्तपद,  a रेफ or a षकार present in the पूर्वपद  causes the णत्व of the नकार present in the  एकाच् उत्तरपद whenever the नकार is (1) at end of a प्रातिपदिक, or (2) created due to a  नुमागम, or (3) part of a विभक्ति.

8.4.13.a: पूर्वपदात् रषाभ्यां प्रातिपदिकान्त-नुम्-विभक्तिषु कुमति नः णः,  अट्कुप्वाङ्नुम्व्यवाये अपि
8.4.13.e: In a compound, the second member of which contains a guttural, there is ण in the room of न , that follows anything which standing in the prior member is qualified to cause the change, provided the न be at the end of a प्रातिपदिक , or be the augment नुम् , or occur in a विभक्ति।

8.4.14.a: पूर्वपदात् उपसर्गात् रषाभ्याम् ण-उपदेशस्य नः णः, असमासेऽपि
8.4.14.e: A धातु which has णकार in the औपदेशिक form get णत्वम्   in presence of an उपसर्ग  that has रेफ or षकार.

8.4.15.a: रषाभ्यां उपसर्गात् हिनु मीना नः णः
8.4.15.e: The  नकार associated with the forms of the verbs  हि and  मी is converted to णकार in presence of a रेफयुक्त उपसर्ग.

8.4.16.a: उपसर्गात् रषाभ्यां लोट् आनि नः णः
8.4.16.e: A रेफ present in an  उपसर्ग causes the णत्व of  नकार of the  'आनि' प्रत्यय of लोट्-लकार.

8.4.17.e: A णत्वनिमित्तक उपसर्ग causes the  णत्व of the उपसर्ग 'नि' attached to the following verbs -  गद्, नद्, पत्, पद्, मा, सो, हन्, या, वा, द्रा, प्सा, वप्, वह्, शम्, चि, दिह् , and also for घुसंज्ञक verbs.

8.4.18.a: रषाभ्यामुपसर्गात् उपदेशे कखादौ अषान्ते शेषे नेः नः विभाषा णः
8.4.18.e: A णत्वनिमित्तक उपसर्ग causes an optional णत्व of the उपसर्ग 'नि' attached to the verbs that are not ककारादि, not खकारादि, not षकारान्त and not mentioned in <<नेर्गदनद..>> [[8.4.16]] sutra.

8.4.19.a: रषाभ्यां  उपसर्गात् पदस्य अन्तः नः णः
8.4.19.e: When the verb अन् (प्राणने) is used along with a रेफ/षकारयुक्त उपसर्ग (like प्र or परा), its नकार becomes णकार when it appears at the end of a पद.

8.4.20.a: रषाभ्यामुपसर्गात् अनितेः साभ्यासस्य उभौ  नः णः
8.4.20.e: When the verb अन् (प्राणने) is used along with a रेफ/षकारयुक्त उपसर्ग (like प्र or परा), and when such a verb undergoes a द्वित्व, then both of the नकारs become णकार.

8.4.21.e: When the word हन्  comes after an उपसर्ग containing a रेफ, the नकार of हन् is converted to णकार only if that नकार is preceded by an अकार, not otherwise.

8.4.22.a: रषाभ्याम्  उपसर्गात् हन्तेः अत्पूर्वस्य  नः वमोः वा णः
8.4.22.e: When the word हन्  comes after an उपसर्ग containing a रेफ, and when the नकार of हन् is preceded by a ह्रस्व अकार,  this नकार is optionally converted to णकार in presence of a प्रत्यय that begins with a वकार or a मकार.

8.4.23.a: अन्तः अत्पूर्वस्य हन्तेः अदेशे नः णः
8.4.23.e: The नकार of हन् is converted to णकार when this word follows the word 'अन्तर्' and when this नकार is preceded by a ह्रस्व अकार. But this णत्व does not happen if the resultant word indicates the name of a place.

8.4.24.e: The नकार of अयन is converted to णकार when this word follows the word 'अन्तर्'.  But this णत्व does not happen if the resultant word indicates the name of a place.

8.4.25.e: In the छन्दस् , न of a second term is changed into ण , when prior term ends with a short ऋ even when there is an अवग्रह or hiatus between the two terms.

8.4.26.e: In the छन्दस् , the न of (the Pronoun) नस् is changed into ण , when it comes after a root having a र or ष or after the words उरु and षु (सु)।

8.4.27.e: The न of नस् is changed diversely into ण , when it comes after an उपसर्ग having a cause of change.

8.4.28.a: रषाभ्याम्  उपसर्गात्  कृति अचः नः णः
8.4.28.e: The न of कृत् affix, preceded by a vowel, is changed into ण , when it follows an उपसर्ग having the cause of change.

8.4.29.a: रषाभ्याम्  उपसर्गात्  णेः कृति अचः  नः विभाषा णः
8.4.29.e: The न of कृत् affix ordained after a causative verb (णयन्त), is optionally changed into ण , when it comes after an उपसर्ग having a cause of change.

8.4.30.e: The कृत् affix, coming after a verb, which begins with a consonant and has a penultimate इच् vowel, changes optionally its न् , which is preceded by a vowel, into ण् , when it comes after उपसर्ग having a cause of change.

8.4.31.e: A कृत् affix ordained after a verb beginning with an इच् vowel, having the augment नुम् in it, and ending with a consonant, changes it s न् into ण् , when preceded by an उपसर्ग having in it the cause of change.

8.4.32.e: The न् of निस् , निक्ष and निन्द is changed to a ण optionally, when preceded by an उपसर्ग having in it a cause of change.

8.4.33.e: The न of a कृत् affix is not changed to ण , though preceded by an उपसर्ग having in it a cause of change, when the affix is added to the following verbs - भा 'to shine', भू 'to be', पू 'to purify', कमि 'to be brilliant', गमि 'to go', प्यायि 'to increase', वेप 'to shake'.

8.4.34.e: After a ष् final in a पद , the न् is not changed to ण।

8.4.35.e: ण् is not the substitute of the verb नश 'to destroy', when ending in ष्।

8.4.36.e: A नकार occurring at end of a पद does not get णत्वम् ।

8.4.37.e: The न् is not changed to ण् when a पद intervenes between the cause of the change and the word containing the न्।

8.4.38.e: The ण् is not the substitute of न् in the words क्षुभ्ना etc.

8.4.39.e: In the context of संहिता, A सकार and a तवर्ग letter are converted (respectively) to a  शकार and चवर्ग letter when associated with a शकार or a चवर्ग letter.

8.4.40.e: In the context of संहिता, A सकार and a तवर्ग letter are converted (respectively) to a षकार and टवर्ग letter when associated with a षकार or a टवर्ग letter.

8.4.41.a: पदान्तात् टोः अनाम् स्तोः ष्टुः न ।
8.4.41.e: Except when followed by the प्रत्यय नाम्, a पदान्तटवर्ग letter does not cause the ष्टुत्वम् of  सकार or a तवर्ग letter that follows it.

8.4.42.e: A तवर्ग letter which is followed by a षकार does not undergo  ष्टुत्वम्.

8.4.43.e: A तवर्गीय letter following a शकार does not undergo श्चुत्वम्.

8.4.44.e: A यर् letter occurring at end of a  पद is optionally converted to an अनुनासिक when it is followed by an अनुनासिक.

8.4.45.e: If र् or ह् is present after अच् letter, then a यर् letter occurring after such a र् or ह् is optionally duplicated.

8.4.46.a: अचः यरः अनचि द्वे वा संहितायाम्
8.4.46.e: The यर् letter that  follows an अच्  letter but is not followed by an अच्  letter is optionally duplicated.

8.4.47.e: The तकार of the word पुत्रादिनी does not get a द्वित्व when this word is used while shouting / while talking in angry tone.

8.4.48.e: A शर्-letter does not undergo द्वित्वम् when followed by an अच् letter.

8.4.49.e: According to शाकटायन, when three or more letters are joined using a संयोग, the द्वित्वम् does not happen.

8.4.50.e: According to शाकल्य, a यर् letter is never duplicated.

8.4.51.e: According to various experts, a यर्-letter following a दीर्घ letter does not undergo द्वित्वम्.

8.4.52.e: A झल्-letter is converted to a corresponding जश्-letter when followed by a झश् letter.

8.4.53.e: A झल् letter present in an  अभ्यास is converted either to a जश् letter or a चर् letter as appropriate.

8.4.54.e: A झल्-letter is converted to a corresponding चर्-letter when followed by a खर्-letter.

8.4.55.e: A झल्  letter is optionally converted to a corresponding चर् -letter when it is not followed by any other letter.

8.4.56.e: The अण् letter of a non-प्रगृह्य word becomes अनुनासिक optionally when it is followed by an अवसान.

8.4.57.e: An अनुस्वार when followed by a यय् वर्ण is converted to the परसवर्ण.

8.4.58.e: An अनुस्वार occurring at end of a पद when followed by a यय् वर्ण is optionally converted to the परसवर्ण.

8.4.59.e: A letter of तवर्ग is converted to a परसवर्ण when followed by a लकार.

8.4.60.e: The स्था and स्तम्भ् are converted to पूर्वसवर्ण when they follow the upasarga उत् ।

8.4.61.e: A हकार following a झय् letter is optionally converted to the पूर्वसवर्ण (i.e. वर्गचतुर्थ).

8.4.62.a: पदान्तात् झयः शः छः वा अटि
8.4.62.e: A  शकार sandwiched between a झय् letter on the left and an अट् letter on the right is optionally converted to a छकार.

8.4.63.e: A यम्-letter sandwiched between a हल्-letter (on left) and the same  यम्-letter (on right) is optionally removed.

8.4.64.a: हलः झरः सवर्णे झरि अन्यतरस्याम् लोपः
8.4.64.e: A झर् letter coming after an हल्  letter is optionally deleted if it is followed by a सवर्ण झर् letter.

8.4.65.e: The स्वरित is the substitute of an अनुदात्त vowel which follows an उदात्त vowel.

8.4.66.e: All prohibit the above substitution of स्वरित, except the आचार्याः - गार्ग्य, काश्यप and गाल्व; when an उदात्त or a स्वरित follows.
